answer.reason: The cited BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 Arizona statewide industry data indicates December 2024 covered employment of 226,731 jobs for NAICS 54, Professional, scientific, and technical services.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Arizona, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 54 Professional, scientific, and technical services?

A. 177,356 covered jobs
B. 226,731 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Arizona statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/04000.csv)
